links.outcome: Expert ability to distinguish synthetic from acquired CT images in modified Turing test
links.effect: Human experts misclassified synthetic images with a false positive rate of 67% and Fleiss' Kappa 0.06, so synthetic images were not reliably distinguishable from acquired ones.
links.quote: In a modified Turing-test, human experts identified synthetic vs acquired images, with a false positive rate of 67% and Fleiss' Kappa 0.06, attesting to the photorealism of the synthetic images.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating GAN-synthesized images with radiomics and deep learning tasks before use in medical imaging applications

screen.reason: Evaluates synthetic CT data generation via Cycle-GAN and tests safety/fidelity via human reader study (Turing test) and downstream diagnostic performance impact.
